name: Cherry Almond Buns

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, diced, at room temperature

instructions.primary_message: Place warm water, yeast, and 1/4 teaspoon sugar together in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Let stand 5 minutes. Add flour, another 1/4 cup sugar, and salt and mix to combine. Add milk and yolks and beat to combine. Add diced butter to the bowl and beat on medium speed for 5 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl, cover dough with a dish towel, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.

In a small bowl, cover cherries with boiling water. Let stand 6 minutes, then drain, gently patting cherries dry. Dry out bowl and combine cherries, almonds, and remaining 1/4 cup sugar until combined; set aside.

Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Roll dough out onto a lightly floured surface to 12- by 41-cm rectangle. Brush rectangle with butter, leaving a 2.5-cm border on all sides. Sprinkle dough evenly with cherry-almond filling. Roll dough up, long side first, gently pressing together at the end to seal.

Dip a very sharp knife in flour then cut roll into 12 equal pieces. Place each bun, cut side down, on prepared baking sheet. Cover with a dish towel and let rise in a warm place until almost doubled in size, 45 minutes. Meanwhile, adjust an oven rack to the center position and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Brush the top of each bun with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar and almonds. Bake until puffed and golden, about 30 minutes. Serve warm.

schema_metadata.keywords: breakfast sweets, Cinnamon Buns, wake and bake, yeast pastries

description: Filled with almonds and cherries, these sweet yeasted breakfast buns make a nice alternative to the traditional cinnamon-raisin.
notes: Total time, including resting: 2 hr 35 min.
author: Carrie Vasios Mullins
